	<item>
		<title>America is in the wrong AI race with China</title>
		<link>https://restofworld.org/2026/america-china-ai-race-trust/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=feeds</link>
		<pubDate>Tue, 22 Sep 2026 10:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator>Rumman Chowdhury and Konstantinos Komaitis</dc:creator>
		<guid>https://restofworld.org/2026/america-china-ai-race-trust/</guid>
		<description><![CDATA[The U.S. is framing its rivalry with China as one of technical superiority, failing to recognize that public trust and robust consumer protections are necessary for long-term dominance.
]]></description>
		
		<media:content medium="image" url="https://restofworld.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/illo_china_us_race_final2-768x432.jpg" width="768" height="432" />

	<media:credit>Rest of World/iStock</media:credit>
		</item>

	<item>
		<title>Google Earth’s AI experiment lasted 24 hours. The damage to trust will linger</title>
		<link>https://restofworld.org/2026/google-earth-ai-deepfake-iran-war/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=feeds</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator>Mahsa Alimardani</dc:creator>
		<guid>https://restofworld.org/2026/google-earth-ai-deepfake-iran-war/</guid>
		<description><![CDATA[A short-lived generative AI feature in Google Earth that allowed users to create fake satellite imagery shows the lasting effects of unvetted AI tools during a conflict.
]]></description>
		
		<media:content medium="image" url="https://restofworld.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/illo_google_earth_doubt_final-768x432.jpg" width="768" height="432" />

		</item>
	<item>
		<title>Now it’s China’s experts who are gig workers training AI</title>
		<link>https://restofworld.org/2026/china-expert-ai-trainers/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=feeds</link>
		<pubDate>Wed, 09 Sep 2026 10:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator>Viola Zhou</dc:creator>
		<guid>https://restofworld.org/2026/china-expert-ai-trainers/</guid>
		<description><![CDATA[Squeezed by a stagnant economy and state directives, China's underemployed lawyers, architects, and engineers are taking cheap gig work to teach AI their exact trades — just to pay this month's mortgage.]]></description>
		
		<media:content medium="image" url="https://restofworld.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/illo_ai_pro_clones_sketch-768x432.jpg" width="768" height="432" />
